items.headline: Will Anderson calls Texans’ loss to Bills a 'wake-up call' for the defense ahead of Bengals visit
items.description: — Houston Texans defensive end Will Anderson said giving up 36 points in a season-opening loss to the Bills wasn’t a reason to get mad but instead should be a catalyst to improve.
